payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort input array, then swap first (min) and last (max) elements to make first element max and last element min, maximizing sum of adjacent differences (first - last).
payload.rationale: The solution relies on sorting to order elements; the final arrangement is obtained by a simple swap. This fits the sorting family. Among given subtypes, sorting_custom_key is the closest as it involves sorting for a specific order, though no explicit custom key is defined.
